summary: Tested backend refactoring from 16,865-line monolith to modular route files. All 23 pytest tests passed. Fixed checklist templates 500 error (Pydantic validation issue with legacy string data). Frontend UI flows verified: login, dashboard KPIs, all navigation tabs (Programs, Companies, Sessions, Staff, Finance, Leads, Settings, HR & Payroll, Invoices) work correctly.

issues: PWA install banner overlays bottom-right corner - minor annoyance but doesn't block functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend refactoring complete. server.py reduced from 16,865 to ~537 lines. All 280+ endpoints moved to /app/backend/routes/. Fixed checklist templates endpoint to handle legacy string items by normalizing to ChecklistItem objects. All navigation tabs work: Programs, Companies, Sessions, Staff, Finance, Leads, Settings, HR & Payroll, Invoices. Direct URL routes like /sessions and /hr show blank pages (frontend routing issue, not backend) - use /admin dashboard tabs instead.
